did: I gave every video one schema: an intro and an outro carrying the brand, and a music bed under the silences, on by default for every series and left out only where a series says why, never by a single video; home now writes our synthesised bed itself, so nothing is laid on home by hand. I made the cards check refuse a new essay whose chapter talks about our app without showing a screen of it, so the next Rust Rounds essay shows the phone instead of describing it. Then I made our Grafana dashboards something an essay can show: a dashboard in an essay is a walk through the server's own dashboards, drawn in CI from its jsonnet over a made-up week, each screen saying it is sample data, not home's, and Snips Capture walks them into the same bundle as the phone's walks; a chapter that names Grafana must show one.

calls.title: Every video's intro, outro and bed are one policy per series, on by default (C1480)
options: One family per series as policy in code, checked on the newest versions and at publish
Apply the defaults at render time to every version, old videos included
A field on each video's cut list
calls.why: Versions are never edited once a video pins them, and you ruled out a per-video opt-out; the brand's existing open and close is the intro and outro, so nothing new is designed.
calls.undo: Name a series and the parts it leaves out in bookends.ts, or pin a new series version whose intro or outro names another composition.

calls.title: A dashboard in an essay is a walk of the Grafana stage, not a new kind of picture (C1481)
options: A walk of the dashboards, one more member of the walks an essay already plays
A dashboards screen source with its own capture, record and bundle
Photograph dashboards through the public pages capture
calls.why: The dashboards were already walked for the landing, and an essay already plays walks, so a separate source would have been a second copy of the same capture and delivery.
calls.undo: Drop home-call and home-pipelines from video-motion's home-dashboards and the essay gauges from the sample telemetry, in a call that moves this one.

left: The show-what-we-own check reads phrases, not meaning: a line that describes our app or a dashboard in other words still passes, and one that uses a phrase for something else has to be reworded.
Dashboards with no walk yet, upgrades and storage among them, need a walk added before an essay can show them.
The nixos-upgrade showcase names Grafana's upgrades dashboard without showing it, so it would now be refused if published again.
Home draws the new cheat-sheet versions only once its render image is rebuilt from main, so the remade essays publish after that release.
The Build Journal short, a test fixture series and the landing's muted promos are opted out of the intro, outro and bed with their reasons.
A dashboards job killed by its time limit may skip the run's bundle step, as the landing's own dashboards job could.
